section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Inter-scale correlations', describes an initial examination of correlates of acceptance of cosmetic surgery in Brazil. It reports bivariate correlations between the ACSS score, General body appreciation, actual-ideal body weight discrepancy, SATAQ-3 subscales, participant age, and self-reported BMI for women and men separately. The findings indicate significant correlations between higher ACSS scores and lower General body appreciation, greater body weight discrepancy, higher SATAQ-3 scores, and higher self-reported BMI for both genders, with a minor exception for men.
